[[Bandit]] can be assigned as a [[slayer task]]. It does not have a required [[combat]] level to be assigned by [[Krystilia]]. Bandits are most commonly found in [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)]].

Along with Bandits and [[Guard Bandit|Guard Bandits]], [[Speedy Keith]], [[Donny the lad]], and [[Black Heather]] can be killed to satisfy the task.

The bandits are guarded by [[Guard Bandit]]. These bandits are aggressive, so players should take caution when approaching the camp. However, camp leaders (like [[Donny the lad]]) are not aggressive.

If you'd like to prioritize barraging the level 130 bandits, you can setup a cannon slightly southwest of the first spear wall near the entrance. This extends the task as you'll only rarely target a single lower level bandit while being able to barrage up to 7 or 8 high level bandits. Their far aggressive range, high hitpoints and fast respawn time make it an effective task for experience. You can quickly teleport out to regain aggression.[[File:Bandit (Bandit Camp entrance) safespot.png|thumb|Safespot west of the entrance of the Bandit Camp]]
